text:
Priya Nair: FYI customers using SDK 5.0 with model-binding are seeing intermittent 409s when we unpin models during rollout. It looks like a race at the release-manager layer. Proposing a short-lived SDK pin for affected cohorts while we fix idempotency. Any major objections?
Jorge M.: Can you share a sample error and which cohorts are impacted?
Priya Nair: Error snippet and tenants: acme-inc-prod, greenfield-test.
```
2026-04-02T14:12:11Z tenant=acme-inc-prod req=aa1b2c status=409 message="model-binding conflict: alias not found during unbind"
Trace: release-manager.go:231 applyUnbind -> race on alias table
```
Jorge M.: That's likely the same race we patched in runtime-3.3.0 earlier but SDK 5.0 changed the unbind handshake. We can either roll a tiny handshake patch or pin SDK for those tenants. Patch ETA ~3.5h.
Priya Nair: To keep customers stable I'd prefer tenant-scoped SDK pin for now. Deploybot supports that. We'll also add a routing shim to serialize unbinds for those tenants.
deploybot: Proposed command: `/pin sdk sdk-4.9.2 scope=tenants:acme-inc-prod,greenfield-test reason="unbind-race-with-5.0" ttl=10800 initiated_by=@Priya Nair`
Priya Nair: Add TTL 3h and set canary 2% so we still get some visibility.
deploybot: Applying pin...
deploybot: Pin applied: PIN-9810 scope=tenants:[acme-inc-prod,greenfield-test] sdk=4.9.2 ttl=10800s canary=2% initiated_by=Priya Nair. To extend: `/deploybot extend PIN-9810 hours=1`
eng-oncall-bot: Change window opened 14:30-18:30 UTC for potential rollback/patch promotion. Notifying SRE on-call.
SRE Pager: Suppressing noisy 409 alerts for pinned tenants. High-severity channel remains active. PagerDuty on-call paged.
Jorge M.: I'll land a tiny compatibility shim in runtime that accepts the SDK 5.0 unbind handshake and serializes alias mutation. PR link when ready.
Priya Nair: Can someone update release notes/CS blurb: short note "Tenant-scoped SDK pin (PIN-9810) due to unbind race with SDK 5.0; temporary measure while compatibility shim is deployed."
Release Ops: Added changelog entry and notified CS. PR: https://git.redwood/release-notes/pins/9810
Jorge M.: Telemetry checks: count of 409 unbind errors and alias-table write conflicts per tenant every 5m. If errors fall <1/min for 20m we can unpin early.
deploybot: Monitoring: will auto-unpin PIN-9810 when TTL expires unless extended. Event will be posted to #release-ops on unpin or removal.
Priya Nair: Thanks all. Keep this thread for telemetry snaps and unpin decision. If we see any regressions outside the pinned tenants, escalate here immediately.
